block.neroarcade.arcade_cabinet.tooltip: Insert a cartridge, then use it with an empty hand to play. Sneak-use to take the cartridge out.
block.neroarcade.arcade_exchange.tooltip: Publish your games for the whole server, and download games others made.
block.neroarcade.cartridge_duplicator.to: Copies a cartridge onto a Blank Cartridge, keeping its credit.
block.neroarcade.game_bench.tooltip: Build a game from module chips, test it, and save it to a Blank Cartridge.
block.neroarcade.link_bus.tooltip: Joins up to four cabinets, through up to 16 Link Cables, into one game. The cabinet holding a cartridge runs it; the others become extra seats.
block.neroarcade.link_cable.tooltip: Connects cabinets and Marquee Screens to a Link Bus. Glows while a linked game is on.
block.neroarcade.marquee_screen.tooltip: On a Link Bus it shows the game being played there, and its top ten between games. Sneak-use to change its size.

gui.neroarcade.menu_open_failed: This screen could not be opened on this server. The server log has the details.
item.neroarcade.blank_cartridge.tooltip: Put it in a Game Bench tray and save a game onto it.
item.neroarcade.blank_chip.tooltip: Craft it with one more item to make a module chip — each chip's recipe is in the wiki and the recipe viewer.
item.neroarcade.module_chip.stacks: Up to three %s chips fit in one game.
item.neroarcade.module_chip.unknown: A chip this server does not know.
link.neroarcade.push.downloaded.title: Cartridge downloaded
link.neroarcade.push.record: Your record on %s was beaten — now #%s
link.neroarcade.push.record.off: Your record on %s was beaten — you are off the top 10
link.neroarcade.push.record.title: Record beaten
module.neroarcade.arena.grid_16.desc: A 16 by 16 board with a wall border and optional obstacles.
module.neroarcade.arena.grid_32.desc: A 32 by 32 board with a wall border and optional obstacles.
module.neroarcade.arena.ring_24.desc: A 24-wide tube that wraps left to right, with optional pillars.
module.neroarcade.arena.strip_9.desc: A 9-wide lane that can scroll new wall gates toward the pawn.
module.neroarcade.control.four_way.desc: Up, down, left and right to move, plus the A and B buttons.
module.neroarcade.control.one_button.des: One action button and one alternate; the pawn moves on its own.
module.neroarcade.control.twin_stick.des: Move with the pad, aim with the stick, fire with A.
module.neroarcade.control.two_way.desc: Left and right (or up and down) plus two buttons.
module.neroarcade.hazard.bouncing_ball.d: A ball that bounces off walls and bats and scores past a goal line.
module.neroarcade.hazard.chaser.desc: A drone that walks toward the nearest pawn through the maze.
Crates drop from the top at random; dodge or catch them.
module.neroarcade.hazard.laser_sweep.des: A beam with one gap sweeps back and forth; slip through the gap.
module.neroarcade.hazard.shrinking_floor: The outer ring of the floor falls away at a steady interval.
module.neroarcade.modifier.fog.desc: Only a circle around your pawn is visible.
module.neroarcade.modifier.low_gravity.d: Falling things fall slower; hops last longer.
module.neroarcade.modifier.mirror.desc: Your controls are flipped on one or both axes.
module.neroarcade.modifier.wrap_around.d: The edges join up: leave one side, arrive on the other.
module.neroarcade.multiplayer.coop.desc: Two to four players share one board and, by default, one life pool.
module.neroarcade.multiplayer.solo.desc: One player has the whole board.
module.neroarcade.multiplayer.turns.desc: Players take turns at one cabinet; pass the controls when told.
module.neroarcade.multiplayer.versus.des: Players compete on one board; last one standing or best score wins.
module.neroarcade.pace.pulse.desc: Alternates bursts of full speed with slow stretches.
module.neroarcade.pace.ramp.desc: Starts slow and speeds up to full speed in steps.
module.neroarcade.pace.steady.desc: The game runs at one constant speed. Slow-down 1 is full speed; 4 is a quarter of it.
module.neroarcade.pawn.cursor.desc: A free cursor that moves in four directions and stops at walls.
module.neroarcade.pawn.paddle.desc: A slide-along bar that bounces hazards and shots back.
module.neroarcade.pawn.runner.desc: Runs on its own; tap to hop over hazards, steer to change lane.
module.neroarcade.pawn.serpent.desc: Always moving; grows with each pickup and dies touching itself.
module.neroarcade.pawn.ship.desc: Drifts with inertia and fires shots where it points.
module.neroarcade.pawn.stacker.desc: Guide falling pieces; full rows clear and score.
module.neroarcade.pickup.key.desc: Keys that unlock the exit; without one they are worth 5 points.
module.neroarcade.pickup.score_orb.desc: Orbs worth points; they return unless the rule is to clear them.
module.neroarcade.pickup.shield.desc: Grab it to shrug off the next hits for a while.
module.neroarcade.pickup.speed_boost.des: Grab it to move faster for a while.
module.neroarcade.rule.clear_board.desc: Collect every pickup before the clock runs out.
module.neroarcade.rule.last_standing.des: Last pawn alive wins; alone, survive the solo clock.
module.neroarcade.rule.reach_exit.desc: Find the exit; with a key it stays locked until every key is held.
module.neroarcade.rule.score_target.desc: First to reach the target score wins.
module.neroarcade.rule.survive_time.desc: Stay alive until the clock runs out.
module.neroarcade.theme.cindara_dusk.des: Ember reds and dusk amber under a warm sand glow.
module.neroarcade.theme.hangar.desc: Graphite deck, hazard yellow and field blue.
module.neroarcade.theme.neon_void.desc: Dark void, magenta pawns, cyan exits — the house look.
module.neroarcade.theme.terminal_green.d: One-colour phosphor ladder with a single white hot spot.
neroarcade.bench.credit_hint: Your name is not saved with your games or scores. To show it, run /neroarcade privacy credit on (you can turn it off again any time).
neroarcade.bench.ghost: From the loaded cartridge — clear it to place your own chip.
neroarcade.bench.ghost_tip: From the loaded cartridge — press ✕ on this row to clear it.
neroarcade.bench.help.clear: Remove the chips that came from the loaded cartridge, so you can put in your own.
neroarcade.bench.help.load: Put the tray cartridge's chips in the rack so you can change them.
neroarcade.bench.help.prop.bool: %s: click to turn it on or off.
neroarcade.bench.help.prop.enum: %s: click for the next choice, right-click for the previous one.
neroarcade.bench.help.prop.int: %s: click or drag to set it; the mouse wheel steps by %s.
neroarcade.bench.help.row: Click the row to edit this chip's settings on the right.
neroarcade.bench.help.save: Write this game onto the cartridge in the tray.
neroarcade.bench.help.stop_test: End the test play and keep the bench open.
neroarcade.bench.help.test_play: Play this game right here with the arcade keys (%s %s %s %s, %s). ESC stops it and closes the bench.
neroarcade.bench.help.title: Your game's name, 1 to %s characters. It shows on the cabinet.
neroarcade.bench.params_empty: %s is empty. Put a chip in the slot to add one.
neroarcade.bench.params_empty_default: %s is empty, so the game uses %s. Put a chip in the slot to change its settings.
neroarcade.bench.preview_caption: Live demo — restarts on every change
neroarcade.bench.status.busy: ARCADE BUSY — too many games are running. Try again soon.
neroarcade.bench.status.failed: That did not work. The server log has the details.
neroarcade.bench.status.hint: Hover any slot or button to see what it does.
neroarcade.bench.status.loaded: Loaded. The rack now shows that game.
neroarcade.bench.status.need_blank: Put a Blank Cartridge in the tray.
neroarcade.bench.status.need_cartridge: Put a cartridge in the tray to load it.
neroarcade.bench.status.need_title: Give your game a title first.
neroarcade.bench.status.not_yours: That cartridge is another builder's. Put a Blank Cartridge in the tray to save your remix.
neroarcade.bench.status.other_cartridge: That is a different game. Put a Blank Cartridge in the tray, or LOAD this one first.
neroarcade.bench.status.seated_elsewhere: You are seated at a cabinet. Leave that seat first.
neroarcade.bench.status.test_started: Test play started. Press ESC to stop.
neroarcade.bench.status.testing: A test play is running. Stop it first.
neroarcade.bench.subtitle: Drop chips in the rack. Empty slots use the default shown in grey.
neroarcade.bench.testing_over: Test over — %s plays again, ESC closes the bench
neroarcade.bench.tray_hint: Blank Cartridge to save, or a cartridge to load.
neroarcade.bench.warning.aim_without_fir: This control aims, but the pawn cannot fire. Aim is ignored.
neroarcade.bench.warning.clear_board_wit: There is nothing to clear, so this plays as a survival game.
neroarcade.bench.warning.crowded: Three hazards on a small board with a moving pawn: expect short games.
neroarcade.bench.warning.exit_on_one_axi: The pawn moves on one line, so the exit is placed at the far end of that line.
neroarcade.bench.warning.key_without_exi: Nothing uses the key, so it counts as an orb worth 5 points.
neroarcade.bench.warning.no_threat: Nothing can hurt the pawn, so this is won by waiting.
neroarcade.bench.warning.one_button_free: With one button the pawn moves on its own: A reverses, B stops.
neroarcade.bench.warning.score_rule_with: This rule needs points, but no pickup gives any. The match can only end by lives or time.
neroarcade.bench.warning.two_way_on_free: This control moves on one axis, so the pawn will too.
neroarcade.bench.warning.unknown_propert: Some settings are not used by this server and will be removed when you save.
neroarcade.bench.warning.versus_needs_se: Needs 2 seats. Link another cabinet, or it plays solo.
neroarcade.bench.why.cannot_run: This game cannot run yet — the status bar says why.
neroarcade.bench.why.invalid: This game cannot be saved until the problem in the status bar is fixed.
neroarcade.bench.why.need_blank: Put a Blank Cartridge in the tray to save.
neroarcade.bench.why.need_cartridge: Put a saved cartridge in the tray to load it.
neroarcade.bench.why.need_title: Type a title for your game first.
neroarcade.bench.why.waiting: Waiting for the bench to answer.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.already_seated: You are already seated at X %s, Y %s, Z %s. Leave that seat first.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.blank: This cartridge is blank. Save a game onto it at a Game Bench first.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.bus_full: BUS FULL — a Link Bus joins at most four cabinets.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.coin_op: You could not pay for this seat, so it was given back.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.conflict: LINKED — REMOVE CARTRIDGE. Another cabinet on this bus already runs the game; sneak-use to take this cartridge out.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.eject_in_progress: A match is running. Leave your seat before taking the cartridge out.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.hot_seat_host: HOT-SEAT — this game passes one set of controls around. Play at the cabinet holding the cartridge.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.in_progress: Match in progress. Wait for it to end.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.inserted: Cartridge in. Use the cabinet with an empty hand to play.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.linked_insert: This cabinet is linked — the host cabinet holds the bus's cartridge.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.no_cartridge: NO CARTRIDGE — insert one to play.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.no_host: LINKED — WAITING. Put a cartridge into one cabinet on this bus to play.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.no_power: NO POWER — this cabinet needs power to play.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.no_seat_here: This game seats fewer players than this bus has cabinets. Use a cabinet closer to the Link Bus.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.occupied: This cabinet already has a cartridge. Sneak-use to take it out.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.runtime_failed: This game stopped with an error; the cartridge may use a combination this server cannot run.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.taken: Taken — someone is already playing here.
neroarcade.cabinet.msg.your_turn: An arcade cabinet is free now. Use it again to play.
neroarcade.cartridge.error.bad_id: This cartridge has an invalid id.
neroarcade.cartridge.error.bad_title: The title must be 1–32 plain characters.
neroarcade.cartridge.error.newer_schema: This cartridge was made on a newer version of NeroArcade.
neroarcade.cartridge.error.over_budget: This game exceeds this server's limits (%s).
neroarcade.cartridge.error.too_large: This cartridge is too large to read (%s KB, limit %s KB).
neroarcade.cartridge.error.unknown_modul: This cartridge uses a module this server does not have (%s). Ask the server owner.
neroarcade.command.awake: Arcade hosts running now: %s of %s (%s waiting for a slot). A host with nobody seated and nobody near falls asleep after runtime.sleepAfterTicks.
neroarcade.command.credit.off: Credit is off. Your name has been removed from every leaderboard on this server, and games you save from now on say "Anonymous builder". Cartridges you already gave away keep what they carry.
neroarcade.command.credit.on: Credit is on. Games you save from now on, and your new leaderboard scores, will show your name (%s). Turn it off any time with /neroarcade privacy credit off.
neroarcade.command.credit.status_off: Credit is off (the default): your scores show as "Anonymous" and your games say "Anonymous builder". Turn it on with /neroarcade privacy credit on.
neroarcade.command.credit.status_on: Credit is on: your new scores and saved games show your name. Turn it off with /neroarcade privacy credit off.
neroarcade.command.export.cooldown: You asked for an export a moment ago. Try again in %s seconds.
neroarcade.command.export.done: Your NeroArcade data was written to %s in the world folder. Ask the server operator for the file; it is deleted after %s days.
neroarcade.command.export.failed: Your data could not be written. Ask the server operator to check the server log.
neroarcade.command.gallery.built: Gallery built: %s cabinets running demo games, a link row under a marquee, and %s games on the Exchange. Stand inside it and use /neroarcade gallery clear to remove it.
neroarcade.command.gallery.cleared: Gallery cleared: %s blocks put back and %s Exchange listings taken down.
neroarcade.command.gallery.creative_only: Switch to creative mode to build or clear the gallery.
neroarcade.command.gallery.no_replays: The gallery's demo games are missing from this copy of the mod.
neroarcade.command.gallery.nothing_here: There is no gallery here. Stand inside one to clear it.
neroarcade.command.gallery.occupied: The gallery's space holds %s blocks with contents (chests, machines). Move somewhere empty first, so nothing is lost.
neroarcade.command.gallery.others_nearby: Someone else is within %s blocks. Build the gallery in a test world with nobody nearby.
neroarcade.command.gallery.players_only: Only a player can build or clear the gallery.
neroarcade.command.inspect.not_cartridge: Hold a cartridge in your main hand.
neroarcade.command.top.empty: No scores yet. Play it to set the first one.
neroarcade.command.top.nothing: Hold a cartridge, or look at an arcade cabinet, to see its scores.
neroarcade.command.unpublish.none: %s has no listings on the Exchange.
neroarcade.duplicator.deny.need_blank: Put a Blank Cartridge in the blank slot.
neroarcade.duplicator.deny.need_original: Put a written cartridge in the original slot.
neroarcade.duplicator.deny.no_power: No power — arcade machines need it on this server.
neroarcade.duplicator.deny.output_full: Take the finished cartridges out first.
neroarcade.duplicator.deny.unreadable: Cannot copy: this game uses chips this server lacks.
neroarcade.duplicator.help.copy: Copies the original onto one Blank Cartridge. The copy keeps the game's credit.
neroarcade.duplicator.subtitle: An original and a blank make two identical cartridges.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.author_full: You already list %s games — unpublish one first.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.disabled: The Exchange is switched off on this server.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.failed: That did not work. Try again.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.gone: That game is no longer here. The list has been refreshed.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.heart_rate: You can give %s hearts an hour. Try again later.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.need_blank: You need a Blank Cartridge in the tray to download.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.need_cartridge: Put a written cartridge in the tray or hold it in your hand to publish it.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.no_author: This game has no author, so only an admin can publish it.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.not_yours: Only the game's author (or an admin) can publish it.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.own_heart: You cannot heart your own game.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.payment: The download could not be paid for.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.replace_not_you: A game with this id is already listed by someone else. Only an admin can replace it.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.title_blocked: Title not allowed. Rename the game at the Game Bench.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.title_invalid: Give the game a title of 1 to %s characters at the Game Bench first.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.unpublish_not_y: Only the game's author (or an admin) can unpublish it.
neroarcade.exchange.deny.unreadable: This game uses chips this server does not have, so it cannot be used here.
neroarcade.exchange.disabled_banner: The Exchange is switched off on this server.
neroarcade.exchange.empty: No games yet. Publish one from the tray to be the first.
neroarcade.exchange.empty_drafts: No drafts. Games you send from the NeroLink app wait here for 30 days.
neroarcade.exchange.help.download: Writes a copy of this game onto the Blank Cartridge in the tray.
neroarcade.exchange.help.drafts: Games you sent from the NeroLink app. Only you can see them; they are deleted after 30 days.
neroarcade.exchange.help.fetch: Writes this draft onto the Blank Cartridge in the tray and removes the draft.
neroarcade.exchange.help.games: Every game published on this server, most hearted first.
neroarcade.exchange.help.heart: Gives this game a heart. Hearts only sort the list.
neroarcade.exchange.help.publish: Lists the cartridge in the tray (or in your hand) on the Exchange. You must be its author.
neroarcade.exchange.help.unpublish: Takes this game off the Exchange. Copies people already downloaded stay theirs.
neroarcade.exchange.hint: Put a Blank Cartridge in the tray, pick a game, press Download.
neroarcade.exchange.hint_drafts: Put a Blank Cartridge in the tray, pick a draft, press Fetch.
neroarcade.exchange.ok.replaced: Updated %s on the Exchange; its hearts and plays are kept.
neroarcade.exchange.pick: Pick a game in the list to see its slots, then download it onto a Blank Cartridge.
neroarcade.exchange.slot_default: Empty — the game uses the default
neroarcade.exchange.subtitle: Download a game onto a Blank Cartridge, or publish your own.
neroarcade.exchange.tray_hint: Blank to download, game to publish
neroarcade.exchange.why.select: Pick a game in the list first.
neroarcade.legend.aim_stick: Aim: the aim keys (arrows by default)
neroarcade.legend.one_button: No steering: the pawn moves on its own

neroarcade.seat.dropped.fault: This game hit a fault and stopped.
neroarcade.seat.dropped.host_gone: The cabinet running this game is gone.
neroarcade.seat.dropped.power: The cabinet ran out of power.
neroarcade.seat.dropped.range: You walked away from the cabinet, so your seat was released.

slot.neroarcade.arena.desc: The board: its size, its walls and whether its edges wrap.
slot.neroarcade.control.desc: How the buttons turn into movement and actions.
slot.neroarcade.hazard.desc: What threatens the pawns; up to three hazards stack.
slot.neroarcade.modifier.desc: One twist on the whole game, such as wrapping edges or fog.
slot.neroarcade.multiplayer.desc: How many players take part and whether they team up or compete.
slot.neroarcade.pace.desc: How fast the game runs and whether it speeds up.
slot.neroarcade.pawn.desc: What each player controls and how it moves.
slot.neroarcade.pickup.desc: What the pawns collect; up to three pickups stack.
slot.neroarcade.rule.desc: How a match is won or lost.
slot.neroarcade.theme.desc: The colours, sprites and sounds of the screen.
